title: India's Semiconductor Failure
summary: Asianometry explains why India, a chip design powerhouse, cannot fabricate chips, tracing the 1980s government attempt to build a national semiconductor champion and how it collapsed. It includes the sabotage at the SCL fab.
why: HN uses it as the source on India's early fab attempts, in threads about India's semiconductor ambitions.

quote.text: India had sound policies it was quite ahead of time when it created SCL, check this video for more
